items.name: Santa Tecla Cubo Desafio 2018

venue.name: [Palacio Tecleño](https://www.facebook.com/palaciosantatecla)
venue.address: 2da Avenida Norte y Paseo Concepción,  No. 2-1 Santa Tecla, El Salvador

items.information:
El costo de la inscripción es de $5.00 en Pre-Inscripcion y el dia del evento. (Incluye participación en todas las categorías). 
El Registro debera hacerse en esta pagina, se tomaran datos de competidor el dia del evento pero la competencia tiene un limite de 100 personas. De alcanzarce dicho limite no se podra participar en la competencia.
-Se podra pagar previamente en la cuenta detallada en la Pestaña de "Informacion de Pago" con un costo de $5.

items.name: Geethanjali Cube Open 2018

venue.name: [Geethanjali College Of Engineering And Technology](http://www.geethanjaliinstitutions.com/engineering/index.html)
venue.address: Geethanjali College Of Engineering And Technology, Cheeryala, Keesara.

items.information:
Partipants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 21st january 2018 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 19th january 2018 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 19th january 2018 9:00pm IST.
Please note once you register in WCA site for the Geethanjali Cube Open 2018, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events.
Additional information will be provided in the tabs.

items.name: Siginjai Open 2018

venue.name: [Stikom Dinamika Bangsa](http://www.stikom-db.ac.id)
venue.address: Jl. Kutilang I No.1, The Hok, Jambi Sel., Kota Jambi, Jambi 36122
venue.details: Lomba akan dilaksanakan di Kantin Stephen (the venue is on the Stephen Canteen)

items.information:
Ini merupakan Kompetisi ke-2 di Jambi dikhususkan untuk Cuber Sumatra Wilayah Selatan. Pendaftaran sistem on the spot dengan biaya Rp. 75,000 untuk semua event. Diselenggarakan oleh KRJ (Komunitas Rubik Jambi). Silahkan baca pada tabs yang ada atau hubungi panitia untuk informasi lebih lanjut.
________________________________________________________________
This is the second competition in Jambi, spesial for Sumatra South Region Cuber. Registration on the spot system with fee Rp. 75,000 for all event. Organized by KRJ (Komunitas Rubik Jambi). Please look on the tabs or contact the organizers for more information.

items.name: Wolfpack Winter 2018

venue.name: NC State Talley Student Union
venue.details: Mountains Ballroom on the 3rd floor (one floor up from where you walk in)

items.information:
Competition located in Mountains Ballroom on the 3rd floor of Talley Student Union. 
Competitor Limit: 100
Competitor Fee: $18 (free for NC State Students see NCSU Student tab for more info)
Your registration is not complete until you pay. You will be placed on a waiting list until you pay. With the WCA system, registration must be manually checked before approval, so please allow up to **48 hours** to be moved from the waiting list.

items.name: Lions Cubing 2018
items.information: There is a 100 person competitor limit. The registration fee is a flat $15. Spectators are welcome to attend for free.
